issues.description: Logical contradiction in the WHERE clause: the solution file aufgabe05.sql (line 4) uses an AND between two mutually exclusive equality checks on the same attribute: (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'), which can never be true. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 37) explicitly asks for Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern. As a result the provided solution will return no rows and contradicts the task instructions, which will confuse students who expect an OR condition.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the WHERE condition match the problem statement by using OR (or IN). For example: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern')  -- or: AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk IN ('Oberbayern','Niederbayern').
